company_p1: Ezer is the Hebrew word for “one who helps.” LaEzer’s philosophy begins with this name: helping each person discover their own unique beauty. We aim to be a company that customers and business partners alike can rely on.
company_p2: Founded in Daejeon, Korea in 2024, we entered Mongolia as our first export market and are now preparing to expand into Russia, Central Asia, Japan and Vietnam.
slogan_p: We combine the principles of nature with modern science to deliver skincare that restores the skin’s natural radiance.

brand_title:

brand_p: Grounded in scientific evidence such as research papers and ingredient efficacy analyses, LaEzer proposes a skincare routine tailored to each individual’s skin.
pr1_title: Systematic R&D grounded in scientific evidence
pr1_text: We design precise formulas from skin science and ingredient efficacy data, and objectively verify efficacy and irritation through human application and irritation tests.
pr2_title: Precise ingredient blends tailored to each skin concern
pr2_text: Each skin concern calls for different ingredients. We analyze the properties and role of each one and develop formulas whose complementary blends deliver what the skin needs.
pr3_title: Harmony between nature and modern science
pr3_text: By combining naturally derived ingredients with modern skin science, we offer skincare that nurtures the skin’s healthy balance and helps restore its natural radiance.

routine_lead: Edelweiss plant stem cells and patented Derma-Clera™ awaken the skin’s natural ability to recover.
step1_text: A pathway made by nature, not needles: natural sponge spicules open micro-channels to help active ingredients absorb. The slight tingle on first application wakes up the skin and boosts the next steps.
step2_first: Plant stem cells from the Alps for intensive care.
step2_text: Ingredients derived from the plant stem cells of edelweiss grown at 3,000 m revitalize the skin, while 9 peptides support firmness and a healthy skin condition.
step3_first: Long-lasting moisture that protects the skin.
step3_text: Patented Derma-Clera™ gently shields the skin from external irritants while supplying rich moisture and nourishment. From week two, skin feels firmer and smoother.
routine_note: Order and frequency follow the official product page · spicules may cause a tingling sensation

ing_title: Ingredients of the LaEzer Callus Repair line
ing1_v: Antioxidant power 2 times stronger than vitamin C. Edelweiss plant stem cell extract delivers a comfortable feeling of moisture to dry, sensitized skin.
ing1_m: Edelweiss that changes the skin’s time
ing2_v: Peptide boosting wraps the skin in firm inner elasticity. It firmly protects a skin balance that is easily upset by even minor irritation and supports care for a condition that does not break down.
ing2_m: The key ingredient of slow aging
ing3_v: A plant-derived patented ingredient from Baekmi flower comfortably soothes skin sensitized by irritation and gently cares for disrupted skin balance.
ing4_v: 11 hyaluronic acids of varied molecular sizes, from high to low molecular weight, replenish moisture evenly from the skin’s surface to its inner layers, keeping skin hydrated and free of dryness.
ing5_v: Fine needle-like spicules derived from natural marine sponge gently refine dead skin cells the moment they touch the skin and deliver active ingredients deep into it.
ing_note: * The above applies to the properties of the raw ingredients only.

howto_title: LaEzer’s 3-step repair routine that replenishes the skin’s own strength
how1_1: After cleansing, prep your skin with toner, then apply a suitable amount of the CICA Capsule Spicule Ampoule.
how1_2: Apply over the entire face, except the eye and lip area, with a gentle rolling motion.
how1_3: Apply gently along the direction of the skin’s texture, then finish by pressing firmly with your fingers.
how1_note: * We recommend using the CICA Capsule Spicule Ampoule once every 2 days. (The interval may be lengthened depending on your skin type.)
how2_1: After cleansing, prep your skin with toner, then apply a suitable amount of the Callus Repair Ampoule.
how2_2: Apply over the entire face with a gentle rolling motion.
how3_1: After cleansing, at the last step of your basic skincare, take a suitable amount, spread it thinly, then pat lightly to help it absorb.
how3_2: Once the first layer has absorbed, apply a second layer and let it absorb to stay even more hydrated, with no worry about inner dryness.
